40. INSTALL FIFTEEN BOLTS IN VALVE BODY
Install the bolts as shown.
Torque: 100 kg-cm (7 ft-lb, 10 N-m)

41. INSTALL DETENT SPRING

42. INSTALL OIL STRAINER
Torque: 55 kg-cm (48 in.-lb, 5.4 N-m)

43. CONNECT SOLENOID WIRING TO EACH SOLENOID
(a) Push the solenoid wiring through in the transmission case and connect the terminals to each solenoid.
(b) Clamp the wiring to the screen.
(c) Install the gromet for the wiring with the plate.

44. INSTALL OIL TUBES
Press the tubes by hand into the positions indicated in the figure. Make sure that the oil tubes do not interfere with the oil pan.
